top1.title: 【2026-10-31】Googleの宇宙AI実証衛星が稼働、搭載モデルが俳句を生成
top1.lead1: GoogleのSuncatcher実証衛星が稼働し、搭載AIモデルのGemma 4が宇宙を題材にした俳句を生成した。
top1.lead2: 今後は熱や放射線によるTPUへの影響を検証。電力制約があり、大規模な宇宙データセンターの実現はまだ先の段階だ。

top10.title: [2026-10-31] Google's space AI demonstration satellite becomes operational, onboard model generates haiku
top10.summary: Google's Suncatcher demonstration satellite has become operational and generated haiku using its onboard Gemma 4 model. It will next examine the effects of heat and radiation in orbit on TPUs.

top10.title: [2026-10-31] Starbucks considers AI-personalized drive-through menus
top10.summary: Starbucks is considering digital menus tailored to individual customers. It also plans to begin testing AI to assist with order entry in 2027; no timeline has been set for introducing the menus.

top10.title: [2026-10-31] Zest introduces AI for finding and booking restaurants through messages
top10.summary: Restaurant discovery app Zest has introduced AI that suggests restaurants and makes reservations within messages. It reconciles preferences in group chats and also supports voting.

top10.title: [2026-10-31] [Analysis] Theranos whistleblower warns of difficulties vetting AI investments and fraud risks
top10.summary: An analysis article presents remarks by Tyler Shultz. It highlights the importance of technical due diligence by investors, noting the difficulty of distinguishing proprietary technology from applications of existing AI.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
editorsDesk.bonusNote: 今日のおまけアニメ。クリックで再生。

topCards.title: 【2026-10-31】Zest、メッセージで飲食店探しから予約まで行うAIを導入
topCards.summary: 飲食店発見アプリのZestが、メッセージ内で店の提案や予約を行うAIを導入。グループチャットで好みを調整し、投票にも対応する。
